title: VBF: vectorial Boolean function analysis
description: A Julia library for analysing vectorial Boolean functions, focused on APN functions and the linear, affine, EA, and CCZ equivalence hierarchy. It ships a curated catalogue of APN functions with provenance (declaration files, import code and SHA-256 digests of every imported source) and paper-reproduction scripts. This version is the one cited in the undergraduate thesis "Reprodutibilidade computacional na literatura de funções APN" (UFSC).
